title: Checking the object contents
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload reduce ((tag, obj = {}) -> obj ++ { (tag.name): tag.value })

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload reduce ((tag, obj = {}) -> obj ++ { (tag.name): tag.value })

explanation.approach: Both keys survive in the output. This is unlike a traditional map where the second value would overwrite the first. DataWeave treats objects as ordered lists of pairs, so both remain.
